sections.heading: Answers from the trading systems desk

items.question: Do your MT5 indicators repaint?
items.answer: No. Our calculation models strictly bind to closed micro-ticks. Once an entry arrow prints, it remains permanently on your MT5 chart history.

items.question: Can I use the indicators on mobile phone (Android / iOS)?
items.answer: MT5 indicators (.ex5) run on Windows PC or VPS. However, our VIP Signals Channel sends identical real-time entry alerts directly to your mobile phone via Telegram.

items.question: What is the recommended minimum starting balance?
items.answer: For Boom 1000 and Crash 1000, you can start with as little as $50 - $100. For the $100k Challenge, the entry requirement is exactly $100.00.

items.question: How fast do I receive my download and license key?
items.answer: Instantly and automatically. As soon as your crypto payment confirms on the blockchain, your license key and .ex5 download package unlock right on your screen.
